The nodes that place their children (containers, flex rows and columns, grids, reorderable lists) and the settings of position, overflow and alignment.
Learn: [Layout](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/layout/), [Flex layout](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/flex-layout/), [Grid layout](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/grid-layout/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Align`](/reference/layout/align/) | enum | A side or the middle along one axis: start, center or end. |
| [`Axis`](/reference/layout/axis/) | enum | The horizontal or the vertical direction. |
| [`ContainerNode`](/reference/layout/containernode/) | class | A node that draws nothing and groups its children, to move, clip or scroll them together. |
| [`FlexNode`](/reference/layout/flexnode/) | class | Places its visible children one after the other in a column or a row, and takes the size of its content. |
| [`GridNode`](/reference/layout/gridnode/) | class | Places its visible children in rows that wrap at its width, and takes the height of its content. |
| [`OverflowProperty`](/reference/layout/overflowproperty/) | enum | What a node does with the children that go past its bounds. |
| [`PositionProperty`](/reference/layout/positionproperty/) | enum | Whether a node is placed inside its parent or on the canvas. |
| [`ReorderableFlexNode`](/reference/layout/reorderableflexnode/) | class | A flex column or row whose children the user reorders by dragging them. |
